simple.summary: חֲתַת (chăthath) means dismay First listed occurrence: Job 6 21.

definitions.full: H2866. chathath I. חֲתַת noun [masculine] terror — only ח ׳תִּרְאוּ וַתִּירָ֑אוּ Job 6:21 (>Baer ִתּירְאוּ for תִּרְאוּ ) ye see a terror, and fear (note paronomasia in Hebrew; see Di).
